posts.name: Templify AI
posts.tagline: Powerful content editor for people who aren’t editors
posts.description: Templify is an all-in-one video, photo, and carousel editor for iPhone. With 1,200+ designer templates, it turns clips and photos into Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, and collages in minutes, no timeline needed. Features include AI video editing, beat-synced transitions, auto captions, background removal, filters, and an AI Studio. Free to use, with an optional Pro subscription.

posts.name: Filament by Galaxy
posts.tagline: Move data using your terminal or agent. Fast & open source.
posts.description: Filament is a data replication engine written in Go. It supports full loads, incremental replication, and change data capture (CDC). As data moves through the engine, Filament verifies Arrow batches at the sink handoff and, where the sink supports it, checks the exact serialized payload. You can run Filament as a standalone binary or embed it in a Go application.

posts.name: Claude Meetings
posts.tagline: Add Claude to your call and get work started as you talk
posts.description: Claude Meetings lets you add Claude to a Google Meet call as a visible participant. The team can ask questions out loud or in chat, and Claude writes the notes and action items so no one on the call has to. It builds docs, whiteboards, and other artifacts during the call, and teammates on the invite can edit them as you talk. After the call, the notes, transcript, and anything Claude made are on the meeting page in Claude. It is in beta on Team and Enterprise plans, starting with Google Meet.

posts.name: Replicate
posts.tagline: Turn Webflow/Framer app into a Claude/Codex project for free
posts.description: Replicate a Webflow, Framer, or any website-builder project into a NextJS app with 1:1 parity. Migrating off of website builders is difficult due to image CDNs, CMS parity, and minified JS code. Replicate handles all of these problems and commits your code to a GitHub repository. The best part? It's entirely free.

posts.name: Trainn MCP
posts.tagline: Create product videos and courses from any AI chat
posts.description: Give your AI tools the power to create training content, not just plan it. Connect Trainn MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or any AI agent to turn recordings into product videos, write help articles and build courses through chat. When your product changes, update content through the same conversation. Nothing ships, without your permission.

posts.name: Gemini 4 Hydrogen
posts.tagline: Fast agentic development for coders
posts.description: Build faster with Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Google’s new model for cost-efficient agentic coding and debugging. Start building in Google AI Studio today.

posts.name: qorqbot
posts.tagline: Proactive agent for business work
posts.description: qorqbot is proactive qorqbot runs on subscriptions you already pay for - Claude, Codex, and more. It is provider-agnostic and built for business workflows and complex, long-running tasks qorqbot manages your attention, and gets work done in the background. it learns from you, without you actively teaching it, and synthesizes your preferences, workflows, and context naturally qorqbot is not a harness - it sits around your harness, providing operational, context, UX, and self-adjustment layers

posts.name: Ganella
posts.tagline: Your Mac Dock, with live widgets for the apps you use
posts.description: Ganella replaces the macOS Dock with a native one where the apps you choose become live widgets: Spotify and Music controls, your calendar, open browser tabs, Xcode builds, terminals and AI agents like Claude, Codex and ChatGPT. Plus clipboard history, app folders, a position per display and four styles including Liquid Glass. 7-day free trial, no signup. $9.99 once.

posts.name: Paxper
posts.tagline: Create cloud infrastructure visually and review every change
posts.description: Visual infrastructure as code: design cloud resources on a diagram, review every change, and apply it in your own AWS account.

posts.name: Google Pixel Tag
posts.tagline: Google’s $30 Android-ready tracking tag
posts.description: Google Pixel Tag is a $29.99 item tracker built for Android. Attach it to your keys, wallet, or luggage and find your belongings through Google's Find Hub network of over 1 billion Android devices. Get precise directions with a compatible phone, ring nearby items, or double-press the tag to find your phone, even on silent. Its slim, water-resistant design includes a replaceable battery lasting over a year. Works with Android 9 and newer.

posts.name: GAtrends
posts.tagline: Spike alerts for your keywords in Telegram, Claude, ChatGPT
posts.description: GAtrends is a trend radar for your own keywords. It watches 7 sources (Google News, Hacker News, Wikipedia, Steam, Google Trends, GitHub, Product Hunt), learns the usual level of each keyword and alerts you the moment one spikes. Alerts land in Telegram on every plan. Connect Claude or ChatGPT and ask what is rising. Dashboard with charts, signal history, CSV export, webhook and API. Free plan: 3 keywords, no card.

posts.name: Aven App Agent
posts.tagline: AI that guides users through your app
posts.description: Add AI guidance to your app. Users can ask how to do a task and get a walkthrough that highlights the right controls. Your team defines what Aven can guide, and your app handles navigation.

posts.name: WHOOP Humans
posts.tagline: WHOOP's social network built around real health data
posts.description: WHOOP Humans brings a new social experience to the WHOOP app, built around real health and performance data. Follow friends and family, see the Sleep, Recovery, Strain, and activities they choose to share, and encourage each other's progress. Capture meaningful moments with photos, notes, and the data behind them. Unlike traditional social feeds, WHOOP Humans connects people through their real-world experiences, with granular privacy controls.

posts.name: Burnstate
posts.tagline: Claude Code, Codex & Cursor limits, paced in your menu bar
posts.description: Burnstate is a native Mac menu bar app for people who code with AI. It shows your Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Vercel AI Gateway limits, marks how much of each window has passed, and tells you when you'd run out at your current pace. Answer Claude Code permission prompts and questions from a card, see every session's tokens and cost, take breaks that count only time away, and share a year of usage as a link. No account, no analytics.

posts.name: de:volt
posts.tagline: A breadboard simulator with real physics, in your browser
posts.description: de:volt is a breadboard simulator that runs real circuit physics in your browser. Wire up 105 parts on a 400 or 830-point board and the circuit runs as you build. Probe it with a 4-channel scope and multimeter, program an Arduino Uno or Nano, micro:bit or RP2040, learn with guided lessons that pass on real measurements, or run a whole class with assignments, marking and live lessons.

posts.name: Willo
posts.tagline: A companion you talk to while you play WoW
posts.description: A little wisp who rides along while you play World of Warcraft. Ask her anything out loud and hear the answer in her own voice.

posts.name: Expo Simulators
posts.tagline: Cloud simulators built for agents
posts.description: Expo Simulators are platform agnostic cloud simulators that allow agents to install a build, drive it, and verify their own work, running as many in parallel as you need.

posts.name: Hoverine
posts.tagline: Rive animation templates you can drop into your app
posts.description: Interactive Rive animation templates: buttons, loaders, toggles, forms and more, each with a working state machine. Start free, upgrade for the full catalogue and a commercial license. Includes Riv Eye, a free in-browser ".riv" inspector.

posts.name: StockRip
posts.tagline: Trading cards, literally digital cards with tokenized stocks
posts.description: The original stock trading cards. Collect companies, not cardboard: rip a pack and pull digital cards loaded with tokenized stocks like Nvidia, Tesla and SpaceX. Keep them to build a portfolio, sell back instantly or gift a pack with a link.

posts.name: Pocket Studio for Supabase
posts.tagline: Supabase dashboard & SQL editor for Android
posts.description: Pocket DB is a private Supabase dashboard for Android: browse tables, run SQL on Postgres, check storage, logs and usage, and get alerts when a project needs you. Free plan, no ads, no tracking.

posts.name: Kairos
posts.tagline: Personal analytics engine across health, finances, & social
posts.description: Kairos connects every stream—health vitals, bank transactions, calendar, music, messages—and surfaces the patterns in your own data, never cross-user comparisons. Rate your energy, mood, and focus each morning to see what actually drives how you feel. The system describes, you decide.

posts.name: miingl social
posts.tagline: Free Intelligent Social Media Management
posts.description: One system for human and AI content. miingl social learns your brand, schedules, and publishes posts your team or AI creates across 11+ platforms. Mix both per channel, and nothing goes live until you approve it.

posts.name: Pocket+
posts.tagline: DJI Osmo Pocket made more capable for content creators.
posts.description: Pocket+ turns your DJI Osmo Pocket into a powerful Mac camera. Everything you need to monitor, control, and record, right from your Mac. - Full-screen camera monitoring - Precise gimbal control & zoom - Smart face tracking - Saved scenes & instant switching - Color adjustments & LUTs - Up to 4K video recording and more... Works with OBS, Zoom, Google Meet, all modern browsers. Supports Pocket 2, 3, 4, and 4P. Free to get started. Built by a content creator, for content creators.

posts.name: Qwen4-Max-Preview
posts.tagline: A multimodal AI model for reasoning, coding, and agents
posts.description: Qwen4-Max-Preview is Alibaba’s advanced AI model designed for complex reasoning, coding, and multimodal understanding. It helps developers and creators work with text, images, video, and AI-powered tools through a unified AI experience.

posts.name: Flowout 3.0
posts.tagline: Your Webflow team for website design, development and growth
posts.description: Flowout is your website team for strategy, design, development and growth. We help B2B SaaS and enterprise marketing teams migrate, build and improve their websites. Flowout 3.0 introduces our new identity and rebuilt website, reflecting the team we've become and the work we do today.

posts.name: EVPick
posts.tagline: Compare electric cars in plain words
posts.description: Confused by range, kWh and charging? Ask EVPick in plain words. It checks 1,900+ versions from 84 brands, with list prices in 11 countries, and shows which electric cars fit your budget, your trips and your family. Free to use, in nine languages.

posts.name: Spark
posts.tagline: Build a Machine God
posts.description: Train an AI from a single spark. Raise money, skip the evals, launch it to everyone. Safety is our top priority.

posts.name: A Novel Appetite
posts.tagline: Read by the vampire. Against his will.
posts.description: You are a vampire. You own a bookstore. You prey only on bad authors. Literally making the world a better place. A Novel Appetite started as a book, became a game (live on the App Store), and today it drops as a podcast: 8 episodes, ~33 minutes, read by Aspen under protest. Every episode ships with a full transcript — read them all at aspen.mrbray.com/podcast. Free on Spotify and Apple Podcasts. Launched on Friday the 13th, because of course it was. 🧛

posts.name: Marta
posts.tagline: AI assistant for apartment hunting in Spain
posts.description: Marta calls Spanish landlords and agencies for you, filters dead listings, and books your viewings straight into your calendar.

posts.name: PHORM
posts.tagline: Turn any photo into a 3D print. No modeling, no fixing
posts.description: PHORM turns one photo into a print-ready 3D model for your FDM printer, with Bambu Lab in focus. No good photo? Generate or edit one right in PHORM. Engrave or emboss a name, logo or QR code into the mesh, repaint any part and set the real size. High quality, with colors from the photo, ready for AMS. Before you download, PHORM repairs the mesh and checks printability, so you pay for models that print, not attempts. STL or 3MF for Bambu Studio. 2 free models, no card needed, packs from $4.99.

posts.name: allumet
posts.tagline: Queer-centric matchmaking: no swiping, just introductions
posts.description: allumet is a gay-first dating app with no swiping and no endless grid of profiles. You talk with Lumi, an AI matchmaker, by voice or text about what you want and how you handle the hard moments. He writes you a private relationship blueprint, then introduces you to a few people you're compatible with, in both directions, with a note on what's worth talking about. Paying never buys access to people: everyone's in the same network.

posts.name: Convia Pro
posts.tagline: Turn every episode into a multi-platform campaign
posts.description: Built for experts who hate managing content. Convia Studio is the hub for everything you’ve ever said on mic. It transcribes, tags and understands every episode, then turns each one into a story-driven campaign across 11 platforms, built from your actual words, not generic AI copy. Guests get share kits, nothing posts without your approval, and your back catalog keeps working as Convia resurfaces past moments when they’re relevant again. Run it from any AI assistant via our MCP server.

posts.name: Kaizen: Focus & Study Timer
posts.tagline: Focus timer, app blocker and camera-free study rooms
posts.description: Studying alone is the hard part, not the timer. Kaizen puts other people in the room: join a Focus Room and work alongside others as avatars with live timers, no camera or microphone. Run Pomodoro or stopwatch sessions, block distracting apps on iPhone, iPad and Android while you focus or on a schedule, and keep habits, tasks and focus stats in the same app instead of three separate ones. Free with no ads, on iPhone, iPad, Android, Windows and the web.

posts.name: BetterTabs
posts.tagline: every open tab in Chrome's side panel
posts.description: A Chrome side panel that lists every open tab by website.

posts.name: Hollr.to
posts.tagline: Your personal inbox link. Encrypted on arrival.
posts.description: Your personal contact link: hollr.to/you. Messages are encrypted in the sender's browser with your public key. A focused way to receive a first hello. MIT code.

posts.name: Wonderchat
posts.tagline: AI Customer Service Agents with a Built-in Helpdesk
posts.description: AI customer service and sales agents with a built-in helpdesk. Resolve and deflect up to 75% of support tickets across web chat, email, and mobile. Manage all customer conversations in one shared inbox, with unlimited seats at no extra cost. You only pay for AI replies and resolutions. A Zendesk alternative without per-seat pricing. Start free.

posts.name: Smitten
posts.tagline: First dates that feel like the second
posts.description: Smitten is the dating app where you get to know someone before you say hi. Guess their answers, play quick games together, and start a chat that doesn't begin from zero. So when you meet, it already feels like a second date. Free on iOS and Android.

posts.name: Upty
posts.tagline: Website, API & server monitoring in one workspace
posts.description: Keep track of your websites, APIs and servers in one workspace. Upty brings uptime, certificates, domains, DNS, scheduled jobs and application logs together, so developers and small teams can spot issues without switching between tools.

posts.name: reads.city
posts.tagline: Find reading clubs and places to read, city by city
posts.description: reads.city is a local reading discovery platform. Find reading clubs, book cafes and places to read in your city, see when the next meetup is, and check in with the book you're reading. Free for readers and for the clubs that run them.

posts.name: LibreCorsa
posts.tagline: Free, open-source 500 Hz racing sim in a browser tab
posts.description: Drive 2026 open-wheelers, GT3s, a V8 prototype and a road car on 16 circuits in a browser tab. 500 Hz physics, thermal tyres, rain, AI races, a weekly challenge and an open online race every 20 minutes. Free, MIT code, no ads.

posts.name: Late Brake
posts.tagline: How late can you brake at Monza, Spa and Monaco?
posts.description: Monaco’s barriers, Spa’s Eau Rouge, the Monza chicanes: all at true scale, one click away in your browser. Shave tenths off your own ghost, race AI or three friends online, and chase gold on every circuit. Cut a corner, and the lap is deleted.

posts.name: Plot
posts.tagline: Stay on top of your projects, literally.
posts.description: Plot is a 3D project tracker in your Chrome new tab. Track tasks, shipped work, decisions, and learnings in each project, and view your devotion visualized in a 3D landscape.

posts.name: Shelter41
posts.tagline: Coding agents that keep working after you close your laptop
posts.description: Run Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents in the cloud, each on its own isolated machine. Keep your repo, tools and conversation context together, move local sessions to the cloud, and let teammates pick up the work. Manage agents from the web, CLI or SDK, with no seat fees and per-second compute billing.

posts.name: FlyOnTheWall
posts.tagline: No Bots. Just you, your Mac, and private, accurate notes.
posts.description: Turn your meetings into AI-powered notes, insights, and action items without sending your recordings to the cloud. Search and chat with past meetings, organize them into projects, and connect with your favorite tools—all while keeping your recordings private and on your Mac.

posts.name: Animdock
posts.tagline: Animdock is a free creative toolkit in your browser
posts.description: Animdock is a free creative toolkit in your browser: procedural motion design templates you export to MP4, a royalty-free stock library of images, transparent PNGs, music and sound effects, and 20+ private online tools for images, video, audio and PDFs. No sign-up, no watermark.

posts.name: CheckMarkdown
posts.tagline: Check if AI agents can find and read your Markdown
posts.description: Can AI agents discover and retrieve your website's Markdown? CheckMarkdown runs five read-only checks covering webpage access, Markdown discovery, endpoint availability, Content-Type, and returned content. See exactly what passes or fails, inspect raw Markdown, preview the rendered content, and review technical HTTP details. Just enter a webpage or Markdown URL. No installation required.

posts.name: Blaze
posts.tagline: The native macOS app for WordPress development
posts.description: Build and manage WordPress sites in a native macOS app. Blaze includes PHP 8.1–8.5, managed Nginx and MariaDB, HTTPS, snapshots, blueprints, WP-CLI, and an MCP server for AI assistants. Local development is free; Pro adds remote sync and public tunnels. For Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14+.

posts.name: Catch
posts.tagline: Quick capture for every app
posts.description: Capture a thought and send it to the apps you already use — a real event on your calendar, a real task in your task manager, a real page in your notes. Or catch it for later and send it when you're ready. Unlimited catches, free forever; 12 integrations.

posts.name: Novellae Space
posts.tagline: Write your novel. Keep the whole story in view.
posts.description: Novellea is a writing workspace for novels and long-form fiction. Draft one chapter at a time with your manuscript, story plans, and notes in one place. Reorder chapters as the story changes, attach notes to specific passages, and restore earlier drafts. Bring in a Word document you’ve already started or export your manuscript whenever you need it.

posts.name: Notchday: Habit Tracker
posts.tagline: A habit tracker you buy once, built with care
posts.description: Notchday is a habit tracker for iPhone and iPad with no account and no subscription. Log daily, weekly or monthly habits with one tap, see months of progress on a heatmap, and get a reminder before a day slips away. Check habits off straight from the Home Screen or Lock Screen widget. Free for five habits with every feature; a single purchase adds the insights layer and more habits. Your data stays on your device, with optional iCloud backup.

posts.name: xDitto
posts.tagline: Clone yourself. Get your hours back.
posts.description: xDitto is your AI clone that thinks, talks, and acts like you — it handles meetings, email, follow-ups and busywork that eat your day so you get your hours back. You stay in control. You set guardrails. Your data lives in your private vault. Setup takes ~2 min. Early pilot users are reclaiming 37%+ of the hours lost to repetitive work each week. Get free early access the day we launch — the first cohort gets hands-on help building custom capabilities and connecting their own tools.

posts.name: Paramble
posts.tagline: One button to the best human writing on the internet
posts.description: Paramble is a place to stumble upon the best of human creations on the internet, free and not AI-generated. Press one button and an essay, story, or poem opens on the writer's own site. Press again and you're somewhere else. On the web and in Chrome.

posts.name: startup Scanr
posts.tagline: Daily startup ideas from X
posts.description: A daily feed of real problems from X, paired with potential startup solutions.

posts.name: Docform
posts.tagline: AI-native contract management, hosted in France
posts.description: Docform brings drafting, AI review, approval, negotiation, e-signature and renewal tracking into one contract platform. The AI checks each contract against your playbook and cites the source passage. Data is hosted in France.

posts.name: FlowRec
posts.tagline: The iPhone screen recorder with your face in every app
posts.description: FlowRec 3.0 lets you record any app on your iPhone with your face in a floating bubble that follows you from app to app. On websites, a live green screen puts you right on the page, with no real green screen and no editing. Sonar rings show every tap, and a hidden teleprompter scrolls your script without appearing in the video. Made for app demos, tutorials, support answers, and reactions. Free to try; Pro removes the watermark and time limit.

posts.name: Neural Ranks
posts.tagline: Track if AI cites your brand, by topic not by prompt
posts.description: Neural Ranks shows whether ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews mention your brand. Instead of single prompts, it tracks topics: answer share, who gets cited instead of you, which sources the engines trust, and a monthly action plan.

posts.name: Kantamigo
posts.tagline: Lyrics on every phone for a guitar night with friends
posts.description: An online tool for offline fun. You play guitar, friends scan a QR code and follow the lyrics on their phones as you sing, with no app and no account. They suggest and vote for the next song, and your songbook stays private.

posts.name: Privly
posts.tagline: AI lead generation and outreach for LinkedIn
posts.description: Privly helps B2B founders and agencies find LinkedIn prospects who are already talking about the problems they solve. Add your website to define your ideal customer, then see why each lead matches and what sparked the opportunity. Send personalized LinkedIn messages and automate follow-ups from one workspace.

posts.name: aukimi The Creative Hive
posts.tagline: Sculpt, retopo, texture and ship games in your browser
posts.description: aukimi is a browser-based creative suite for game devs. Sculpt, retopologize, texture, paint, animate and edit video in one workspace, with nothing to install. Retopo takes a dense scan to a game-ready asset: auto remesh, guided topology, hand tools, UV unwrap, baking (normal, AO, curvature, cavity) and LOD export. Built on WebGPU. A game engine with its own BASIC dialect is in development. 14 free tools, no signup: aukimi.com/tools

posts.name: JONGG
posts.tagline: Play American mahjong free with friends or bots
posts.description: Play full American mahjong games free in your browser with friends or standard bots. No Membership or subscription is required to play. Learn the game and plan a game night, with optional paid Membership features and digital tile sets.

posts.name: Message to 2050
posts.tagline: Write today. Nobody can open it until 2050, not even us.
posts.description: A digital time capsule. Write a letter to someone you love and it's sealed with timelock encryption until January 1, 2050. The key doesn't exist yet: a global network of institutions (drand / League of Entropy) will create it that day. On Dec 31 the capsule closes in a "Midnight Wave" around the planet. English, Spanish and Portuguese.

posts.name: HarborIQ
posts.tagline: A smarter workspace for independent insurance agencies
posts.description: HarborIQ helps independent insurance agencies manage clients, prospects, and carrier relationships in one modern workspace. Start with a free, insurance-specific CRM. Add AI-powered intelligence to research carrier appetites and find answers across documents in seconds. Already have an AMS? Keep it. HarborIQ works alongside your existing systems. No per-seat pricing. No contracts. Built for independent agencies.

posts.name: Watchlist AI
posts.tagline: Turn repeat searches into daily or weekly AI updates
posts.description: Turn a recurring question into a scheduled watch. Follow research, company announcements or AI releases, then read focused AI summaries with source links on iPhone or Android. Choose daily or weekly checks. Free plan with optional Pro; usage limits apply.

posts.name: Two Us
posts.tagline: Your WhatsApp chat, turned into a deck of insights
posts.description: Export a WhatsApp chat with your partner or your group, drop the file in, and get a deck of cards showing who texts first, your busiest days, and the habits you never noticed. Free. We never store your chat: it's sent to Google Gemini to write your deck, then discarded.

posts.name: leep
posts.tagline: Always-on Team Intelligence for leaders
posts.description: leep gathers what your Team knows without another meeting, call or message. Tell leep what you want to know (blockers, customer mentions, competitor moves). Each team member gets one short leep a day by email, Slack or Microsoft Teams and responds in seconds by voice or text, with no app or login. Every leep evolves based on what that person has already shared. You get Signals, Actions and a weekday Morning Brief, plus a Team Memory you can search or connect to your other AI tools via MCP.

posts.name: Flow Roadmaps
posts.tagline: Step-by-step business roadmaps with AI on every step
posts.description: Flow Roadmaps lays out the work of running a business in the order it goes. 49 roadmaps cover business functions, industries, software builds and technology, in numbered stages and steps. Every step has a short explanation, and Flow AI answers questions about any step using the roadmap you're reading. Free to read with no account; a new account starts with 9 free credits, about 3 questions.

posts.name: Grove For Mac
posts.tagline: Native Mac workspace for AI coding agents on git worktrees
posts.description: Pick a git worktree and your AI agent (Claude Code, Codex, or any custom PTY agent), a real shell, file tree, GitHub-style diff and git panel all switch with it. Native SwiftUI, $9.99 one-time, no account, 7-day trial.

posts.name: AdsGPT
posts.tagline: Manage all your ad platforms with one AI agent
posts.description: Meet AdsGPT, your AI advertising agent. Connect Google Ads, Meta, X, Reddit Ads and more in one place. Create stunning ad images, videos and copy from scratch with AI. Launch campaigns, analyze performance, manage budgets and optimize your ads through simple conversations. All from your iPhone.

posts.name: Howzat
posts.tagline: School hand cricket with friends, now with a webcam umpire
posts.description: Remember hand cricket in school? Howzat! puts it in your browser. Throw 0 to 6 with your hand, the webcam reads it, and the usual rules apply: match and you're out, otherwise you score. Play the computer or a friend. Free, no sign-up.

posts.name: Cloud Doodle
posts.tagline: Draw on the clouds you photograph in the sky
posts.description: Look up, spot a dragon or a sleeping cat in the clouds, and draw it. Cloud Doodle lets you take or pick a photo of the sky and draw on it with soft brushes (solid, airbrush, neon glow, fine pencil), add stickers, emoji and a dedication, then save or share it in high definition. Made to play alone or with your kids. No account, no ads, free forever, with an optional tip. iPhone, iPad, Mac and Vision Pro, nine languages.

posts.name: SpeakEQ
posts.tagline: Turn Communication Intent Into Impact
posts.description: SpeakEQ is a Communication Intelligence platform that helps people understand how they come across, close the gap between intent and impact, improve through real-time feedback and practice

posts.name: Bridge
posts.tagline: Hypnotherapy at home, guided out loud by AI
posts.description: A six-session hypnotherapy program you do at home, out loud: you talk, Bridge listens and responds, like a private session. For sleep, stress, drinking, vaping and confidence. First month free, then $47 a month, instead of around $1,000 for a private program.

posts.name: PivChart
posts.tagline: Scan India & US stocks by chart patterns and red flags
posts.description: PivChart: Research that thinks like an analyst. Novice or veteran, PivChart turns raw market data into clear, institutional-grade insights. Read a stock's technical structure, investigate financials like a forensic analyst, discover new opportunities, and connect your broker. Built for NSE, BSE and global stocks. Make better trading decisions. Try it at pivchart.com. Investing involves risk.

posts.name: Lucky 7 Fold
posts.tagline: Seven AI-ranked football predictions, refreshed all day
posts.description: Lucky 7 Fold ranks upcoming matches from 30 football leagues and competitions using AI probabilities and bookmakers' odds, and shows the top seven as one accumulator. Each pick has a predicted score, a both-teams-to-score call and recent form. Free on iPhone and Android. Information only, no betting. 18+.

posts.name: MojoInvites
posts.tagline: Free festival wish cards with your family photo
posts.description: Make free custom wish cards for Diwali, birthdays, anniversaries and more with your own family photo, then share them on WhatsApp. No app install required.

posts.name: Qelvix Health
posts.tagline: Clinic Management Software for Doctors
posts.description: An India-built clinic management platform for appointments, patient records, prescriptions, pharmacy inventory, billing, and clinic websites.

posts.name: Feedlyy
posts.tagline: Find breakout Instagram posts and scan Facebook Ad Library
posts.description: Feedlyy is a Chrome extension that finds Instagram posts and Reels beating a creator’s usual views, with a Breakout score on every post. It also scores Facebook Ad Library ads, transcribes Reels (Pro) and exports to CSV, Excel or JSON. Free to start.

posts.name: Sobi Forms - Zero-Bloat WordPress Forms
posts.tagline: The lightest modern form builder for WordPress
posts.description: WordPress form plugins often load heavy scripts across your site, even when no form is present. Sobi Forms keeps things lean: around 5 KB of front-end assets where a form appears, and zero elsewhere. Build contact, quote, support, or job forms with drag-and-drop. Get conditional logic, multi-step forms, file uploads, built-in SMTP, webhooks, Brevo and Mailchimp integrations, plus a Gmail-style inbox. Just modern forms without the bloat. Built for freelancers, agencies, and WordPress site owners.

posts.name: ExerciseGIF
posts.tagline: Exercise GIFs that show which muscles work
posts.description: ExerciseGIF is a library of exercise animations made based on real movement, with the working muscles highlighted on every clip. 265 exercises so far, each with steps, tips and muscle data, as GIF, WebP and MP4, with a female and a male figure. Change colors & background. Buy a muscle-group pack from $29 or the 250-exercise library for $249. An API and an MCP server for AI assistants are in early access.

posts.name: Wanoh Digital Website Check
posts.tagline: Passive security, speed, and SEO checker for SMB sites
posts.description: Check any public business website in seconds. Inspect HTTPS, security headers, spam signs, server response time, mobile viewport tags, indexability, and SEO metadata straight from your browser.

posts.name: ExerciseGIF
posts.tagline: Exercise GIFs that show which muscles work
posts.description: ExerciseGIF is a library of exercise animations made based on real movement, with the working muscles highlighted on every clip. 265 exercises so far, each with steps, tips and muscle data, as GIF, WebP and MP4, with a female and a male figure. Change colors & background. Buy a muscle-group pack from $29 or the 250-exercise library for $249. An API and an MCP server for AI assistants are in early access.

posts.name: Papertrade
posts.tagline: Paper trade 45 stock markets, or let your AI agent trade
posts.description: Papertrade is a free paper-trading simulator for 45 stock markets, from NSE and NYSE to Tokyo, London and Hong Kong. Day-trade live prices or replay any past day minute by minute, with the real fees and taxes of 172 brokers like Zerodha, Robinhood and Trading 212. A built-in MCP server lets Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other AI agents trade too, so you can see if your AI makes good calls before it touches real money. Free, no card.

posts.name: MojoInvites
posts.tagline: Free festival wish cards with your family photo
posts.description: Make free custom wish cards for Diwali, birthdays, anniversaries and more with your own family photo, then share them on WhatsApp. No app install required.

posts.name: Fruitful Orchard System
posts.tagline: Plan for goals and bills without linking your bank
posts.description: Know what you can spend today and still cover upcoming bills and save for what matters to you. Fruitful Orchard starts with your Why, then uses 12 months of actual expenses to show what to set aside each payday and whether you’ll have enough when bills come due. Try the free sample with a preloaded household plan. No bank connection or daily expense tracking required.

posts.name: Captverse
posts.tagline: The AI operating system for growing businesses
posts.description: Captverse is an AI business operating system: CRM, deals, inventory, payments, WhatsApp, voice, campaigns and AI agents on one identity and one data layer. Start with the one app you need today and add the rest later without migrating anything. Built for retail, manufacturing, healthcare and service businesses. Free to start.

posts.name: Lucky 7 Fold
posts.tagline: Seven AI-ranked football predictions, refreshed all day
posts.description: Lucky 7 Fold ranks upcoming matches from 30 football leagues and competitions using AI probabilities and bookmakers' odds, and shows the top seven as one accumulator. Each pick has a predicted score, a both-teams-to-score call and recent form. Free on iPhone and Android. Information only, no betting. 18+.

posts.name: Feedlyy
posts.tagline: Find breakout Instagram posts and scan Facebook Ad Library
posts.description: Feedlyy is a Chrome extension that finds Instagram posts and Reels beating a creator’s usual views, with a Breakout score on every post. It also scores Facebook Ad Library ads, transcribes Reels (Pro) and exports to CSV, Excel or JSON. Free to start.

posts.name: Sobi Forms - Zero-Bloat WordPress Forms
posts.tagline: The lightest modern form builder for WordPress
posts.description: WordPress form plugins often load heavy scripts across your site, even when no form is present. Sobi Forms keeps things lean: around 5 KB of front-end assets where a form appears, and zero elsewhere. Build contact, quote, support, or job forms with drag-and-drop. Get conditional logic, multi-step forms, file uploads, built-in SMTP, webhooks, Brevo and Mailchimp integrations, plus a Gmail-style inbox. Just modern forms without the bloat. Built for freelancers, agencies, and WordPress site owners.

posts.name: Credit Ninja
posts.tagline: Track every credit card, due date and debt payoff
posts.description: Never miss a credit card payment or pay interest again. Credit Ninja is a spreadsheet that tracks all your cards in one place – no bank logins, no subscriptions. • Payment calendar + payday planner for every due date • Utilization tracker: what to pay before statements close • Best card per spending category to maximize rewards • Debt payoff planner (avalanche or snowball) with your debt-free date Works in Google Sheets and Excel. Lite, Pro and Bundle editions.

posts.name: PivChart
posts.tagline: Scan India & US stocks by chart patterns and red flags
posts.description: PivChart: Research that thinks like an analyst. Novice or veteran, PivChart turns raw market data into clear, institutional-grade insights. Read a stock's technical structure, investigate financials like a forensic analyst, discover new opportunities, and connect your broker. Built for NSE, BSE and global stocks. Make better trading decisions. Try it at pivchart.com. Investing involves risk.

posts.name: Bridge
posts.tagline: Hypnotherapy at home, guided out loud by AI
posts.description: A six-session hypnotherapy program you do at home, out loud: you talk, Bridge listens and responds, like a private session. For sleep, stress, drinking, vaping and confidence. First month free, then $47 a month, instead of around $1,000 for a private program.

posts.name: Qelvix Health
posts.tagline: Clinic Management Software for Doctors
posts.description: An India-built clinic management platform for appointments, patient records, prescriptions, pharmacy inventory, billing, and clinic websites.

posts.name: Maeve Ops
posts.tagline: A guided launch platform for independent medical practices
posts.description: Maeve Ops takes the guesswork out of launching an independent medical practice. Unlike generic checklists or project management tools, it combines 12 guided modules, step-by-step instructions, actionable tasks, practical templates, and progress tracking in one platform built specifically for physician entrepreneurs. It helps users understand not just what needs to be done, but how to do it and in what order, turning a complex launch process into a clear, manageable roadmap.

posts.name: BotLib Atlas
posts.tagline: AI receptionist that answers and books your calls
posts.description: Atlas answers your business line when you're on a job or after hours. It asks what the caller needs, books the slot in your Google Calendar and emails you a recap. Our team builds and tests it with you. Hear your own receptionist free in 2 minutes.

posts.name: Wishly
posts.tagline: Create a Birthday Page for Someone You Love
posts.description: Build a personalised birthday page with photos, music, candles the recipient blows out with their own breath, a 3D photo room, and wishes collected from friends. Shared as one private link.

posts.name: PostAgentz
posts.tagline: Your Pinterest & Instagram, on autopilot
posts.description: PostAgentz puts your Pinterest and Instagram on autopilot. Set up a campaign once: topics, brand voice, audience, SEO keywords, image style, posting hours. AI agents create and publish fresh posts every day. Ten minutes of setup replaces hours of weekly work.

posts.name: Omixa
posts.tagline: Omixa: Clean CSV and Excel Files, Check Data Quality
posts.description: Web app that cleans CSV and Excel files and reports on data quality.

posts.name: Clearing
posts.tagline: A calm day planner your AI agent can talk to
posts.description: Clearing is a calm day planner for Mac and iPhone. It tells you when to do things, not just what. A built-in MCP server lets Claude, Cursor and other AI agents read and update your plan. No account, no subscription. Syncs through your own iCloud.

posts.name: CapiMail
posts.tagline: Transactional email API for developers and AI agents
posts.description: Developer-first transactional email API, ready for AI agents: verification emails, OTP and 2FA codes, password resets, receipts, and alerts from your own verified domain, with an SDK, MCP server and delivery events you can trust.

posts.name: SunNomad: Road Trip Weather
posts.tagline: Find better weather. Go somewhere sunny.
posts.description: Bad weather? Go somewhere better. SunNomad helps you find places worth the drive based on the weather, your location, and how far you want to travel.**
